title: Adreno 5XX crash in `_run_draw_list_command()`
body:
### Tested versions

- Using standard Android export templates for Godot 4.5.1 stable.

### System information

Godot v4.5.1 stable - Vulkan (Mobile) - Various Android and mobile versions (see details)

### Issue description

After releasing our game Rift Riff to Google Play store (using Godot 4.5.1 stable and the standard export presets), we've been seeing a 4.19% user-perceived crash rate which falls into the Bad Behaviour threshold being above the generally accepted 1.09%. I have taken our top 4 issues (in order of most to least occurrences) and made separate issues for each of them

Each issue includes:
- Example crash logs (up to 5 if possible): Both original and the symbolicated Result. We symbolicated the logs after the fact using the Godot_native_debug_symbols.4.5.1.stable.template_release.android and the [ndk-stack](https://developer.android.com/ndk/guides/ndk-stack) methodology
- The crash headline details from Google Console
- The device information from the log examples: Device model, System on Chip, CPU and GPU.

Hopefully this is helpful - please let me know if any other information is needed!
I'll edit these posts with the links to all the other issues to keep them grouped.

This is Crash 1b, which according to Google Play Console is part of [Crash 1](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/112157), but the logs suggest otherwise.

*Update* - I just realized our 2nd most prevalent crash (Crash 2) is actually the same issue as Crash1 (LocalVector::size()), and also contains 4 of the same crashes as this one Crash 1b. I'll just add those data points to this issue as Crash2b logs.

- Crash 1b:
    - Crashes on`/vendor/lib64/hw/vulkan.adreno.so` and the subsequent `RenderingDeviceGraph::_run_draw_list_command`
    - Google Console Crash Grouping info:
        -  **[split_config.arm64_v8a.apk!libgodot_android.so] Java_org_godotengine_godot_GodotLib_step**
        - SIGSEGV
    - 6 Events, but I could only check 35 logs out of the 100+ from crash 1 & 2, so perhaps there are more.
    - occurs across 1 Device
    - Device List:
        1. **Samsung Galaxy A20 (x2)**
            - Qualcomm SDM450
            - 8x ARM Cortex-A53 (1800 MHz)
            - Qualcomm Adreno 506 (600 MHz)
        2b-1. **Samsung Galaxy A20**
            - Qualcomm SDM450
            - 8x ARM Cortex-A53 (1800 MHz)
            - Qualcomm Adreno 506 (600 MHz)
        2b-2. **Galaxy Tab A 2019**
            1. Qualcomm SDM429
            2. 4x ARM Cortex-A53 (1950 MHz)
            3. Qualcomm Adreno 504 (320 MHz)
       2b-3. **vivo 2034(V2101)**
            1. Qualcomm SDM439
            2. 4x ARM Cortex-A53 (1958 MHz), 4x ARM Cortex-A53 (1459 MHz)
            3. Qualcomm Adreno 505 (560 MHz)
        2b-4. **Cat S62 Pro**
            1. Qualcomm SDM660
            2. 4x Qualcomm Kryo 200 (2200 MHz), 4x Qualcomm Kryo 200 (1800 MHz)
            3. Qualcomm Adreno 512 (650 MHz)


My observations:
- `/vendor/lib64/hw/vulkan.adreno.so` and the subsequent `RenderingDeviceGraph::_run_draw_list_command`. These examples strictly had Qualcomm Adreno GPUs.

Other Android issues with RiftRiff:
- [Crash 1 - LocalVector::size()](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/112157)
- [Crash 3 -  RenderingDeviceDriverVulkan::_release_image_semaphore()](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/112160)
- [Crash 4 -  LocalVector::operator[]()](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/112161)
